nodes.title: START HERE — 3-Clip Infinite Continuation Showcase v1.4
widgets_values:
# Herrgotts H3 Infinite v1.4 — 3-Clip v1.4 Showcase

This workflow demonstrates the current v1.4 chain in one queue: flexible FL2VA conditioning, native in-place Masked AV continuations, freeze/brightness-safe video handovers, independent audio-tail protection and automatic AV stitching.

**Requires a current ComfyUI build containing native PR #15375 H3 AV-mask support.**

Recommended Continue defaults are already selected: **39f video context, Net New Content, Full Previous Tail audio, audio feather 0**. Net New Content samples a longer total latent so the requested duration refers approximately to the newly generated visible body.

nodes.title: INFO — Shared model & sampling setup
widgets_values:
### Shared setup
The model, encoder, VAEs, Sigma Shift, sampler and scheduler are reused by all three clips so the chain stays consistent.

This example uses the same values as the tested workflows. SageAttention is optional. If you change resolution, model/VAE or temporal sampling behavior, make the same change for every clip.

nodes.title: INFO — Shared Qwen Reference
widgets_values:
### Shared Qwen Reference 1
Optional Qwen-only identity/style/content guidance used by all three clips in this example. Connecting Qwen Reference 1 on a v1.4 conditioning node reveals Qwen Reference 2, then 3, and so on up to nine.

It is **not** the temporal continuation source and is not a native Ref2VA/DiT reference latent. Motion and audio continuity come directly from the previous H3 AV latent.

Because Picture numbering depends on each clip's connected keyframes:
- Clip 1 here: `Picture 1 = First`, `Picture 2 = Last`, `Picture 3 = Qwen Reference 1`
- Clip 2/3 here: `Picture 1 = Last`, `Picture 2 = Qwen Reference 1`

Check each v1.4 node's `picture_map` output / console log when writing prompts.

nodes.title: CLIP 1 — Auto Handover — Render Freeze Trim — Balanced
INFO — Clip 1 inputs / optional modes
widgets_values:
### Clip 1
This example connects **First Frame + Last Frame**, so Clip 1 runs in FL2VA mode. The v1.4 Start node does not require both:
- neither = T2VA
- First only = I2VA
- Last only = L2VA
- First + Last = FL2VA

For a long continuation chain, the shown keyframe setup is recommended because endpoint keyframes repeatedly pull composition / identity / quality back toward a controlled target.

`Duration = 10 s` is only an example. The actual H3 frame count snaps to the model's valid temporal grid.

nodes.title: INFO — Clip 1 Flexible Start
widgets_values:
### Flexible Start / Conditioning v1.4
Clip 1 uses the v1.4 flexible Start node. Its connected First/Last Frames are native temporal keyframes **and** receive the first Qwen Picture ordinals. Extra Qwen References follow afterward.

The sampler output is both decoded for rendering/analysis and passed directly into Clip 2 as the previous AV latent. No rendered frames are used as continuation context.

First/Last are optional technically, but keeping keyframe anchors is the recommended Infinite Continuation path because they provide the repeated **quality reset** this suite is designed around.

nodes.title: INFO — Sampling block
widgets_values:
### Per-clip sampling
Each clip has its own Guider + Noise + Sampler while sharing the same model/sampling setup.

A major v1.4 difference: **Clip 2 only needs Clip 1's sampler AV latent**. It no longer waits for Clip 1's Auto Handover metadata to construct continuation context. Auto Handover is a separate render/stitch analysis branch.

nodes.title: INFO — Handover + Stitch Ready
widgets_values:
### Automatic boundary handling — v1.4
Each clip keeps one exact **video** handover boundary shared by continuation and stitching.

- Auto Handover detects the unusable final FL2VA landing.
- The visual cutoff is snapped backward to the latest exact Masked-AV video boundary.
- Stitch Ready ends the previous video there.
- The next Continue protects the safe video context ending at that same point.

v1.4 additionally lets audio remain protected beyond this video boundary when the original previous clip still contains useful speech. The discarded freeze/brightness video tail is never reintroduced.

nodes.title: CLIP 2 — Native Masked AV v1.4 from Clip 1
CLIP 2 — Auto Handover — Render Freeze Trim — Balanced
INFO — Clip 2 optional Last Frame
widgets_values:
### Clip 2 endpoint
The connected **Last Frame** is the visual endpoint / quality-reset keyframe for Clip 2. In v1.4 this input is optional; disconnect it if you intentionally want continuation without a new endpoint anchor.

The previous clip is **not** supplied as an image. Its motion/audio history arrives through the direct AV latent connection.

For long chains, keeping a new Last Frame per continuation is still the recommended setup because it gives each segment a fresh visual target.

nodes.title: INFO — Clip 2 Continue v1.4
widgets_values:
### Continue from Clip 1 — v1.4
Recommended settings are already selected:
- `masked_context_frames = 39`
- `audio_feather_ticks = 0`
- `Duration Mode = Net New Content`
- `Audio Tail Carryover = Full Previous Tail`

The protected **video** context is the safe 39-frame window ending before the unusable landing tail. The protected **audio** starts at the corresponding point but may extend through the previous clip's actual remaining audio, so dialogue endings are not needlessly regenerated simply because the video had to cut earlier.

`actual_head_context_frames = 39` still drives the duplicate video-head trim during stitching. Extra protected audio beyond that time remains audible on the visible start of the next clip.

nodes.title: INFO — Clip 2 handover / output
widgets_values:
### Clip 2 becomes both output and source
Clip 2's sampler output already contains the protected AV head plus newly generated future. The Save node stores that **full latent + 39-frame head length**.

Auto Handover then analyzes Clip 2's visible ending for Clip 2's own Stitch Ready trim. It is not needed to feed Clip 3's latent context.

The v1.4 Seamless AV Join uses Clip 1's handover only to align any crossfade to the correct corresponding point inside Clip 2's protected head if Clip 1 had a removed freeze tail.

nodes.title: CLIP 3 — Native Masked AV v1.4 from Clip 2
CLIP 3 — Auto Handover — Render Freeze Trim — Balanced
INFO — Clip 3 optional Last Frame
widgets_values:
### Clip 3 endpoint
This example uses another **Last Frame** as the third visual endpoint / quality reset. It is optional in v1.4, but recommended when your goal is to periodically reset composition, identity and image quality through a long chain.

Change the prompt and endpoint independently while preserving the character/environment constraints you want carried through the sequence.

nodes.title: INFO — Clip 3 / Final Clip / easy extension
widgets_values:
### Continue from Clip 2
This v1.4 Native Masked AV block is the template for Clip 4+. Keep `Net New Content` if Duration should mean approximately newly visible generated content; switch to `Total Generation` if you prefer the old whole-latent duration semantics.

For dialogue, `Full Previous Tail` is recommended. `Match Video Handover` is available as a conservative A/B fallback. Last Frame remains optional and Qwen References can grow from Reference 1 to Reference 9.

nodes.title: INFO — Final clip handover
widgets_values:
### Why still analyze the final clip?
Auto Handover still runs on Clip 3 so its full latent and continuation metadata remain ready if you later extend the chain.

For the **finished 3-clip video**, `Final Clip` intentionally ignores that tail cutoff: it removes only the reused head overlap and preserves the complete final-keyframe landing. If you prefer freeze safety over preserving every final endpoint frame, switch the last segment to `Stitch Ready` as well.

If you add Clip 4 later, switch Clip 3 back to `Stitch Ready` and use `Final Clip` on the new last segment.

nodes.title: FINAL STEP — Automatic AV stitching
widgets_values:
# Automatic AV stitching — v1.4
The stitcher keeps the robust validated video boundary behavior.

- **Safe Tail Bridge:** 0 by default; the option remains Advanced only for legacy/A-B work.
- **Video:** short 4-frame context-aligned cosine blend is optional seam smoothing.
- **Audio:** short 15 ms de-click crossfade remains available.
- **Boundary luminance match:** Advanced legacy fallback and OFF by default.

v1.4 does not try to recover AV-grid-lost video frames. The stable shared video boundary is kept exactly. Extended protected audio is already part of the decoded next clip, so after the normal 39f duplicate-head trim the useful carried speech tail remains automatically.

nodes.title: INFO — Extending the final stitch
widgets_values:
### Adding Clip 4+
Duplicate the final v1.4 Native Masked AV continuation block and add one more **Seamless AV Join v1.4**.

For every continuation, keep the previous clip's `handover` connected. For normal use keep Safe Tail Bridge = 0 and Luminance Match = off. Use `Stitch Ready` for intermediate clips and `Final Clip` only for the current last clip.

For long projects use **04 — Stitch Saved Chain**; saved latents retain the extended protected audio automatically.
